proof_body:
by
  classical
  intro Ω ι _ _ _ I A
  rw [← Finset.sum_div]
  congr 1
  have : ∀ ω : Ω, ((I.filter (fun i => ω ∈ A i)).card : ℝ) = ∑ i ∈ I, if ω ∈ A i then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
    intro ω
    rw [Finset.sum_boole]
  simp_rw [this]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_boole]
  simp
target_source: ∀ (Ω ι : Type*) [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (I : Finset ι) (A : ι → Finset Ω), (∑ ω : Ω, ((I.filter (fun i => ω ∈ A i)).card : ℝ)) / Fintype.card Ω = ∑ i ∈ I, ((A i).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω
